Discover how global businesses leverage Nilos today

Global businesses use our infrastructure to manage their payment operations and offer new product to their customers.

International traders

International traders use Nilos to collect and pay via local bank transfers in emerging markets like Africa and LATAM without having to set up local entities. Our same-day settlement capability and FX cost reduction help improve cash-flow and increase margins.

Explore

Global businesses

Global businesses use Nilos to streamline and automate their financial money flows from and to subsidiaries in emerging countries. Our FX and stablecoin conversion API let them reduce exposure to foreign currency and speed up inter-company transfers.

Explore

Fintechs

Fintechs use Nilos to build and serve stablecoin product to their customers without extra compliance and integration burden. Our global reach and robust API let them speed up their go-to-market on these new offerings from months to 2 weeks.

Explore
